messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of invoice-preview spikes for a few tenants during last night's EU surge. Preview shows ~2-3x token counts compared to actual usage window. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/preview/ingest/tenant/42

ryan: Huh. Is this token accounting or duplicate request events from retries/fallback?

maria: Looks like duplicates from edge retry + fallback to another route. The metering pipeline currently counts each ingest event (no de-dupe) so rapid retries inflate previews.

sanjay: Quick mitigation idea: add a small ingest-side smoothing window (5–10s) to collapse identical fingerprints before the aggregator. Would reduce preview jitter without changing ledger semantics.

maria: example logs from proxy (partial):
```
{"event_id":"evt-abc123","tenant":"42","route":"r1","retry_count":1}
{"event_id":"evt-abc123","tenant":"42","route":"r2","retry_count":2}
```
Both reached ingest within 200ms.

ryan: If we do smoothing, need to define fingerprinting key carefully (event_id + tenant + model_alias?). Also need to ensure we don't hide real concurrent requests. SLA-wise, smoothing should be opt-in per-route or per-tenant.

emily: Downstream caveat: our ledger consumer assumes append-only ordering. Collapsing before aggregator is fine, but if we emit a synthesized "collapsed_count" we must avoid reinterpreting that as a single request for downstream billing math. Maybe send both raw_count and collapsed_count as separate fields.

sanjay: Proposal for a minimal API change: optional header "X-RI-Meter-Smooth: 5s" and an optional de-dupe-key header "X-RI-Meter-Key: event_id". Consumer will prefer de-duped stream if present. Sample ingest header snippet: 
```http
POST /ingest
X-RI-Meter-Smooth: 5s
X-RI-Meter-Key: evt-abc123
```

maria: Will older consumers ignore these headers? We can make smoothing opt-in so nothing breaks. Rollout: canary route -> console toggle per-tenant -> 2-week shadow -> full on.

ops-bot: [ALERT] last_n_hours: 01 | affected_tenants: 7 | anomaly: +180% invoice-preview delta | runbook: /incidents/2026-03-metering-spike

ryan: I can own the PR for ingest proxy + meter forwarder. Dashboard changes: add a "smoothed preview" panel and a "dup rate" heatmap by route. Metric names: ri.meter.preview.smoothed_tokens, ri.meter.preview.dup_rate.

emily: For cost estimation, we need a sample query to translate smoothed vs raw into invoice delta. I can run a backfill on the replay topic once smoothing is enabled in shadow.

maria: Actions: 1) Ryan -> PR for header passthrough + smoothing hook (canary flag). 2) Sanjay -> add fingerprinting config (defaults: event_id+tenant). 3) Emily -> backfill query + cost delta calc. 4) Ops -> monitor dup_rate dashboard and alert threshold >5%. Target: canary in 48h, shadow 7d, then full opt-in rollout. :thumbsup:
